signIn.metaDescription: Sign in to PandaDev to save your progress, XP and streaks.
signIn.title: Welcome to <brand>PandaDev</brand>
signIn.subtitle: Sign in or create an account in one click.

perks.xp: Earn XP and keep your streak
perks.resume: Pick up exactly where you left off

signIn.disabled: Sign-in isn't switched on yet. Lessons are still free to read without an account.
signIn.legal: By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signIn.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reasons.save: Sign in to save “{title}” for later.
reasons.page: Sign in to keep your progress on “{title}”: XP, solved exercises and your code.
reasons.review: Sign in to start your daily review.
reasons.saved: Sign in to see your saved lessons and problems.
reasons.dashboard: Sign in to see your progress, XP and streak.
reasons.practice: Sign in to track the problems you solve and earn XP.

signIn.privacy: We only get your name, email and profile picture. We never post anything for you.
signIn.guestHint: Lessons and practice are free, no account needed.

errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Nothing changed. Try again whenever you're ready.
errors.linked: That account is already connected to a different PandaDev account. Try the other sign-in button.
errors.noEmail: Your account didn't share a verified email address. Add a verified email to it, or use the other sign-in button.
errors.expired: Sign-in took too long or was interrupted. Please try again.
errors.other: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.

account.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account, progress and XP. This can't be undone.
account.reauth: For your safety, please sign out and sign in again, then retry.
account.deleteFailed: Could not delete your account. Please try again.
